top_signals.title: NYSE Parent ICE Raises $3.75 Billion for MarketAxess Takeover
top_signals.summary: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. sold $3.75 billion of US investment-grade bonds on Tuesday, less than two weeks after announcing a $6 billion deal to acquire MarketAxess Holdings Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
